summary: Both integers are capped at one million, so every legal input occupies at most 20 significant bits and the accepted solution uses a fixed sequence of machine-word bit operations; the workload width is too small for honest runtime scaling.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs one AND subset test, one XOR, and one population count on integers whose legal representation is at most 20 bits wide.

The certificate regression exhausts every positive 10-bit (n, k) pair against an independent bit loop, then checks maximum-width subset, impossible, equality, and random legal cases through the same oracle.
